title: Rules; adoption by commissioner.

annotations.heading: Revision Note

bodyHtml:
[§432G-22  Rules; adoption by commissioner.]  The commissioner may adopt rules under chapter 91 for the implementation and administration of this chapter. [L 2013, c 191, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  This section, enacted as §432G-2(e), was redesignated pursuant to §23G-15.
